summary: Enel Chile filed a Form 6-K reporting that its Ordinary Shareholders Meeting approved a final dividend of US$216,043,119 (US$0.00312/share) for FY2025, reflecting 50% of net income, with an interim dividend already paid. The dividend will be paid on May 20, 2026, in Chilean pesos based on the USD exchange rate. This is a routine dividend distribution and does not constitute a special situation event.
